characters.keyboard-dog: Create a production sprite atlas for an 80x80-pixel keyboard screen companion. Exactly SIX frames in a precise 3 columns by 2 rows grid, all cells square, total canvas 1536x1024. Transparent background with actual alpha, no background color or glow. No text, labels, grid lines, borders, logos or watermarks. Cute polished chibi pixel-art inspired illustration, crisp strong dark plum outlines, simple readable shapes, pastel colors with clear contrast. Front view seated at a small cream mechanical keyboard on a narrow pale wooden desktop. Each complete figure including desk fits its cell with an 8 percent transparent margin; fixed camera, identical character scale, head position, torso, keyboard, desk height and baseline across frames. Big head small body, shoulders and hands visible. Six frames in reading order: (1) relaxed idle with both hands/paws resting on keys, eyes open; (2) exact same idle but eyes fully closed for blink; (3) typing LEFT: LEFT hand/paw raised clearly above keyboard and RIGHT pressing keys; (4) typing RIGHT: RIGHT hand/paw raised clearly and LEFT pressing keys. Frames3/4 should make an immediately readable energetic alternating keyboard-smacking loop like a typing-dog animation. Keep body and desk completely stationary across typing frames, only forearms/hands move. (5) happy celebration, both hands/paws raised, cheerful eyes; (6) sleepy with closed eyes and head resting on one hand/paw, still behind the same keyboard. This is one original character repeated six times, no other characters. Character: a fluffy cream-and-caramel shiba dog with round cheeks, floppy rounded triangular ears and a tiny teal bandana. Large cute dark eyes, small black nose, two big soft rounded paws as hands. Friendly cozy keyboard dog; paws particularly expressive and readable. No human hands.
